name: VR BUCH
summary: VR BUCH is a breakout-based Expert Advisor that identifies price consolidation ranges (buch/clusters) and enters trades when price breaks out of these ranges. It systematically places pending orders at range boundaries and manages positions with stop-loss and take-profit levels based on the breakout range height.
summary_zh: VR BUCH是一个基于突破策略的智能交易系统，它识别价格盘整区间（筹码密集区），当价格突破这些区间时入场交易。系统在区间边界放置挂单，并根据突破区间的高度设置止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: VR BUCH策略的核心概念是识别价格在一段时间内形成的盘整区间或筹码密集区（BUCH在德语中有账簿之意，此处引申为价格密集区域）。入场条件为价格突破盘整区间的上轨或下轨时触发交易，通常通过挂单实现自动入场。出场条件包括基于区间高度的止盈目标，以及设置在区间对侧的止损水平，同时可能包含追踪止损机制来锁定利润。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，也可能根据账户余额进行动态仓位调整。资金管理上，止损比例与盘整区间宽度挂钩，确保风险可控，但具体是否包含最大回撤限制等高级资金管理功能需视参数配置而定。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of VR BUCH strategy is identifying consolidation zones or price cluster areas where price has been ranging for a period of time. Entry conditions trigger when price breaks above the upper boundary or below the lower boundary of the consolidation range, typically implemented through pending stop orders placed at range boundaries for automated entry. Exit conditions include take-profit targets based on the measured height of the breakout range, with stop-loss levels placed on the opposite side of the consolidation zone, and may include trailing stop mechanisms to lock in profits as the trade moves favorably. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading and potentially dynamic sizing based on account balance or equity. Money management ties risk percentages to the consolidation range width to maintain controlled risk exposure, though advanced features like maximum drawdown limits depend on specific parameter configurations.

parameters.description_en: Stop loss multiplier relative to range height

parameters.name: TakeProfitMultiplier

parameters.description_en: Take profit multiplier relative to range height

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA unique ID to distinguish orders across instances

pros: 基于盘整突破的策略逻辑清晰，符合市场规律，盘整后的突破往往具有较强的方向性动力
使用挂单入场避免了情绪化交易，确保在突破确认时才进场，提高了入场质量
止损与区间宽度挂钩的设计使风险管理更加合理，不同波动率环境下风险暴露自适应调整
pros_en: Breakout-based strategy logic is clear and aligns with market principles—post-consolidation breakouts tend to carry strong directional momentum
Pending order entries eliminate emotional trading and ensure entries only on confirmed breakouts, improving entry quality
Stop-loss tied to range width makes risk management more adaptive, automatically adjusting exposure across different volatility environments
cons: 盘整区间识别可能存在滞后，突破信号发出时价格可能已经走出一大段，导致入场点位不佳
横盘震荡市中频繁出现假突破会导致连续亏损，缺乏有效的假突破过滤机制
作为突破策略，在低流动性时段或重大新闻前后容易受到滑点和点差扩大的影响
cons_en: Consolidation range identification may lag, causing entries at suboptimal prices after the move has already extended significantly
Frequent false breakouts in ranging/choppy markets can lead to consecutive losses without an effective false-breakout filter
As a breakout strategy, it is vulnerable to slippage and spread widening during low-liquidity sessions or around major news events
improvements: 增加假突破过滤机制，如要求突破后价格回踩确认再入场，或结合成交量指标验证突破有效性
加入自适应参数优化，根据当前市场波动率(ATR)动态调整盘整区间识别参数和止损止盈距离
improvements_en: Add false breakout filtering, such as requiring a pullback confirmation after breakout or combining volume indicators to validate breakout authenticity
Implement adaptive parameter optimization that dynamically adjusts consolidation detection parameters and SL/TP distances based on current market volatility (ATR)

risk_points: 假突破风险：盘整区间突破后价格可能快速回归，造成止损被触发
参数敏感性：盘整区间识别的K线数量和突破距离参数对策略表现影响较大，不当设置可能导致过度交易或错过机会
risk_points_en: False breakout risk: price may quickly revert after breaking the consolidation zone, triggering stop-losses
Parameter sensitivity: the consolidation bar count and breakout distance significantly impact strategy performance; improper settings may cause overtrading or missed opportunities

It systematically places pending orders at range boundaries and manages positions with stop-loss and take-profit levels based on the breakout range height.
